correctness.rationale: Definitions and period quantifiers are exact. Derive x=(u,not-u,u) and u=(u_even,u_even,not-u_odd) macroblocks; no four alternating or six constant u-symbols, and no 10 alternating or three constant x-symbols. A 3-coprime period of length at least 3p+1 enforces constant u or alternating x. For 3-divisible u periods, decoding complete aligned blocks reduces q to 2q/3 with L to at least 2L/3-8/3; induction gives contradiction for L>=5q-1, including the minimal integer rounding case q_h=2. A purported x factor of length 5p+1 projects to forbidden u factor if p divisible3; p=3 requires six equal u-block symbols and is separately eliminated. The direct x[18:33]=(101)^5 witnesses sharpness. VERIFY.py independently checks 65536 terms and periods through 128. No finite test is asserted to imply the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Resolves a precise named published 2023 conjecture on repetitions in a naturally defined rational-base digit word. Exact fractional critical exponent is a structural invariant, not a finite numerical slice: the proof develops a period-rigidity/desubstitution cutoff uniform in every period and exhibits sharp attainment. The result addresses a nontrivial open boundary raised with the original substitution construction.
